caption:
Ever kick the blanket off then grab it right back?

Most bedding is either heavy enough to trap you in a sweat or thin enough that one shoulder gets cold by morning. Fall nights make it worse, since the temperature swings from the evening to the middle of the night.

This is a fleece throw blanket, queen size, in grey, built to add warmth without comforter weight. Close to a hundred and eighty thousand people rate it 4.6 stars.

A lighter layer you can pull up or kick half off without overheating, for about $20.
